ValidationRule.description: Once a PV is referred (and for every state after it), the station handling it and the referral date must be on the record. Not Initiated records stay freely saveable.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(ISPICKVAL(Status__c, "Not Initiated")), OR( ISBLANK(Police_Station__c), ISBLANK(Referred_Date__c) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Enter the Police Station and the Referred Date before moving police verification past Not Initiated.
